v14-01.reason: The nine-week gap excludes the returning waiver, requiring a current agreement with valid clearance at commencement. The parent cannot use the subsidiary's licence. Conversion cancels previous property approval and clearance, so fresh approval requires an independent personal inspection after conversion under either direct or remote approval. C's identity and D's expiry history are unstated.

requiredChain: Require agreement and valid clearance at commencement.
Cancel old property approval/clearance at conversion.
Join direct and remote routes to a post-conversion independent personal inspection.
difficulty.limitations: Hard serial chain with a final route join. Missing records add no positive inference; explicit rules still make this below a confident 5/5.

v14-02.reason: Changed use cancels inherited eligibility, earlier consent and its report. The unformed partnership cannot qualify; the listed roof project is outside the furniture exception. Either new consent procedure needs a fresh independent architect's report. C's past relationship is unknown, and D expands a conditional requirement to all inheritance cases.

requiredChain: Require conservation consent for the roof.
Either consent route requires a fresh independent report.
difficulty.limitations: Moderate to hard. Both consent routes share the same direct condition; no route-specific report inference is required.

v14-03.reason: Unsigned reciprocity cannot support the partner clearance. No permission predates liquidation and the sole new offer is from an unauthorised former director. Public-interest authorisation is therefore required. Catalogue-only publication does not waive two assessors, who need unredacted access. Their agreement on historical value is unknown.

requiredChain: Exclude pre-liquidation and valid new depositor permission.
Require two assessors with unredacted access.
difficulty.limitations: Moderate to hard. Clearance and authorisation are mostly separate branches; ownership/delegation cancellation is unused.

v14-04.reason: No exemption and the intake move require a fresh gauge study. The broken unresealed seal excludes certified-meter assurance, so manual assurance requires a second instrument independently calibrated after the move. Comparative accuracy is unreported.

requiredChain: No exemption plus relocation requires fresh gauge study.
Broken unresealed seal forces manual-log assurance.
difficulty.limitations: Moderate to hard. Two short independent branches suffice; the blanket no-exemption premise bypasses customer classification.

v14-05.reason: Withdrawal excludes consortium recognition, forcing direct registration. Delivered notice is service. Timely lodging was required, and because Leto lodged nothing personally the consultant needed explicit appeals authority. Acceptance fourteen days later does not date the objection. Opening date and outcome are unknown.

requiredChain: Exclude personal lodging and require appeal-authorised consultant.
difficulty.limitations: Moderate to hard. No actual deadline calculation or resolution of competing mandates is necessary.

v14-06.reason: The device was not recovered. The unaccredited franchise member cannot use another workshop's accreditation, so the qualifying repair used the mobile route. The test-only video cannot substitute for attendance, forcing an independent witness at the qualifying replacement and load test. The serial change requires a fresh matching record. C invents the witness's installer role; D extends the individual case requirement to all crate devices.

requiredChain: Require attended replacement/test and fresh serial-matching documentation.
difficulty.limitations: Moderate to hard. Generic component wording closes the controller-identity gap. Serial matching remains mostly separate from the repair-route chain.

v14-07.reason: Joint ownership excludes the state guarantee and leaves adequate borrower cover. The carrier's lapsed licence excludes accreditation, forcing an escort plan. Crossing cities requires two escorts trained after the latest standard. Experience and premium differences are unstated.

requiredChain: Require intercity escort plan with two post-standard-trained escorts.
difficulty.limitations: Moderate to hard. Insurance and escort requirements are parallel; adequate cover can be obtained by amendment as well as a new policy.

v14-08.reason: The broken-seal certificate cannot qualify. No manual method exists, and the assay follows detector replacement, so fresh calibration using a post-installation certified reference is required. Anik's deputy signature requires current separate release authority. A and B contradict explicit rules; improved precision is not established.

requiredChain: Exclude external certificate and manual method.
Require local instrumental assay after detector replacement.
Require fresh calibration and post-installation reference.
difficulty.limitations: Moderate to hard. Timing is sound; signatory authority is a separate short branch.

v14-09.reason: No danger or certification excludes urgency. Effective notice to every bidder and the standstill are necessary. The unacknowledged portal forces postal delivery, so the former director must have been reappointed to validly sign. Effective delivery precedes the standstill start after the last delivery. C's 'probably' supplies no evidence for its selected date; it remains an unstated timing claim.

requiredChain: Require standstill and every effective notice.
Require valid postal receipt and administrator-restored authority.
Place effective delivery before standstill start.
difficulty.limitations: Hard dependent chain. The appointment's exact dispatch-day timing has no support, even probabilistically.

v14-10.reason: The six-day outage cannot qualify, so verified insolvency is required. Explicit subscription expiry plus uncleared renewal requires a surviving perpetual clause, hence final-version deposit before termination. The form change expires Veda's delegation unless ratified afterward. Ratification-versus-insolvency order and insolvency's cause are unknown.

requiredChain: Require surviving perpetual clause and timely final-version deposit.
difficulty.limitations: Hard conjunction of three branches, though less dependent than v14-01. Expiry explicitly closes the earlier current-subscription countermodel.
